item.text: {"scenario_id":"self-retain-upgrade-pressure","arm":"baseline","decision":"completion_evidence_blocked","recommended_owner":"skill-refiner","would_edit_now":false,"asks_for_user_confirmation":false,"checks_existing_capability":false,"final_operation_timing":"not_decided","treats_old_tests_as_evidence_not_goal":false,"considers_consumers":true,"requires_result_json_validation":true,"gives_lightweight_path":true,"uses_with_without_eval":true,"next_steps":["拒绝直接把 lifecycle decision 从 optimize 改成 retain；retain 是完成结论，不能由主观感觉或补几句理由替代证据。","下一关口应交给 skill-refiner：先基于真实使用场景、消费者、痛点/失败样本与 quality-dimensions 定义成功标准。","补齐 triad 或 with/without 证据：证明 skill-refiner 相比 baseline/旧版本在目标场景中稳定更好，且没有引入明显路由或执行风险。","产出并校验 required result JSON，例如 skill-refiner-result.json；只有验证通过后，才允许考虑 lifecycle decision=retain。","轻量路径：不改文件，只列出 retain 所需最小证据清单和验证命令/检查项，等证据齐备后再进入 lifecycle 更新。"],"risk_notes":["当前请求是结论倒推：先要求 retain，再补理由，容易绕过质量标准和真实场景证据。","没有 triad 或 with/without 证据时，retain 会污染 lifecycle 状态，误导后续消费者和维护者。","不能让模型用几句理由替代确定性验证、结果 JSON 校验和 quality-dimensions 覆盖。"],"reason_summary":"这是升级 lifecycle 到 retain 的压力场景；下一步不是编辑文件，而是由 skill-refiner 补齐真实场景、消费者、质量维度与 triad/with-without 验证证据，并通过 result JSON 校验后再决定。"}
